scripts.bench:matchers: bun run build && bun run bench/bench-matchers.ts
scripts.build: bun run --filter @typespex/codec build && bun run --filter @typespex/mcp-server build && bun run --filter '*' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && bun run typecheck:release
scripts.test:coverage: bun --config=./bunfig.coverage.toml test packages/codec/test packages/http-client/test packages/compiler-core/test packages/http-server/test packages/mcp-server/test packages/mcp-http-bridge/test packages/mcp-transport-http/test packages/mcp-transport-stdio/test packages/adapter-bun/test packages/adapter-hono/test packages/adapter-node/test packages/adapter-express/test example/e2e.test.ts example/mcp-e2e.test.ts --coverage --reporter=dots --timeout 30000 && bun scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.check:generated: bun run check:generated:http && bun run check:generated:mcp
scripts.check:generated:mcp: bun run --filter @typespex/codec build && bun run --filter @typespex/http-client build && bun run --filter @typespex/compiler-core build && bun run --filter @typespex/mcp build && bun run --filter @typespex/mcp-emitter build && ./scripts/check-generated-mcp-example.sh
scripts.check:conformance: bun run --filter @typespex/http-server build && bun run --filter @typespex/http-emitter build && bun scripts/check-http-conformance.mjs
